meta.title: Optimize bandwidth aggregation with out-of-order processing and dynamic allocation
meta.body_summary: Implement out-of-order frame processing and dynamic frame allocation to improve bandwidth aggregation efficiency for unbalanced workers, claiming efficiency gains from ~34% to ~69%.

perf_labels.notes: Devin implemented out-of-order processing and dynamic allocation; maintainer approved with no comments; merged quickly with narrative performance results.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 699 changed lines, this is a medium-sized change by absolute volume, covering multiple files in sender/receiver logic. It fits a substantial performance optimization that was approved and merged without review friction.

review_details.concern_detail: No specific concern raised; maintainer approved without comment.
review_details.performance_claim: Efficiency improved from 34.72% to 69.44% for unbalanced workers, and 100.59% for balanced workers.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Concurrent networking optimization with dynamic allocation and out-of-order processing required deep understanding of Go synchronization; Devin delivered a substantial change set that was accepted without visible feedback.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body includes specific before/after throughput numbers but no script or environment to reproduce.

core_change_summary.description: Implemented out-of-order frame buffering in receiver and dynamic frame allocation in sender based on worker throughput tracking; added configuration flags and performance tracking to Transfer objects.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Client and command updates wire in new optimization flags and adapt to API changes; frame.go adds performance tracking fields.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: out-of-order processing and dynamic allocation in sender/receiver (commit 8481ade4).
Dynamic frame distribution based on worker performance (commit 09b9ecf7).
Fix deadlock in dynamic frame allocation (commit 7b257fa1).
Dynamic rate adjustment based on throughput (commit f4d6754a).
Improve unordered frame processing in receiver (commit 7ee6e4d6).
Direct frame routing to fastest worker (commit f95d1af8).
Final consolidation: optimize bandwidth aggregation with full feature set (commit 3045d1c2).

review_signals.summary: Devin bot announced automatic comment/CI assistance for write-access users.

collaboration_trajectory: Devin opened PR with a series of commits implementing the optimizations, including fixes for deadlock and rate adjustment.
Maintainer approved immediately without review comments.
